rooflines.format: INT4 Group-128 + 16 KiB LM-Head Shadow Cache (hq)

cross_stack_sightline.node_level_anchor: nano-kpu (msh_chip_top): Conservation-of-bytes (76,109 B/tok -> 4,757 cyc/tok floor; 60,013 B/tok -> 3,751 cyc/tok with 16 KiB hq shadow cache) and Little's Law (L = lambda * W = 1 req/cyc * 48 cyc = 48 credits minimum -> 256-deep msh_fetch FIFO) prune impossible proposals in <1 ms and calibrate the 11,200 cyc/tok bet (2.33% error).

fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.connection: Replaces 1,000+ blind cycle-accurate simulator sweeps with analytical roofline and Little's Law pruning, converging in 5 guided simulator calls (200x fewer simulations).
Applies the identical conservation-of-bytes and Little's Law credit-depth equations across scale-out NVLink/RoCE fabrics where widening tensor cores cannot hide bisection bandwidth bottlenecks.

cross_stack_sightline.sightline_takeaway: Analytical rooflines and Little's Law queue sizing govern both a 16 B/cycle KPU DRAM port and a 512-GPU cluster fabric—pruning infeasible candidates before a single cycle of simulation runs.

cross_stack_sightline.node_level_anchor: nano-kpu (msh_chip_top): Three-layer Representation Sandwich float32 (reference/model.py) <--Cosine >= 0.99999999--> Q4.26 (fxmodel.py) <--0 ULP Bit-Exact--> 14 Verilog modules (rtl/msh_*.v). Catches <<13 vs <<14 scale bugs and missing zero-point folds at Row 0 in 50 ms.

fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.connection: Enforces fast executable reference equivalence checks before expensive end-to-end benchmark suites run, preventing optimization edits from introducing subtle semantic drift.
Uses the same Representation Sandwich pattern for Triton/CUDA FP8/INT4 kernels: PyTorch FP32 <--Cosine--> Bit-Accurate Quantized Emulator <--Bit-Exact--> PTX/SASS Kernel.

cross_stack_sightline.sightline_takeaway: Never bridge a floating-point specification directly to low-level RTL or CUDA PTX in one leap; insert a bit-exact software twin so numeric quantization loss and implementation bugs never alias.

labs.title: Adversarial Referees, Chaos Testing & Silicon Synthesis
book_chapters: Chapter 6: Execution Harnesses and Tool Isolation

signoff_proxy_gaps: Pre-layout Yosys/ABC static timing uses statistical 5K_hvratio_1_1 wireload rather than extracted post-route RC parasitics.
All 39 msh_sram and msh_rom instances are synthesized as timing blackboxes priced at 1.0 Mbit/mm2 without macro setup/clk-to-Qliberty arcs.
Timing is evaluated at a single nominal typical corner (Nangate45 typical.lib) without multi-corner multi-mode (MCMM) PVT signoff or clock-tree synthesis (CTS).

cross_stack_sightline.node_level_anchor: nano-kpu (msh_chip_top): Orthogonal referee stack combining static RTL cheat auditing (audit.py), Verilator random-reset (+verilator+rand+reset+2) + 2x DRAM latency chaos (1.0457x elasticity), and two-pass buffered Yosys/ABC Nangate45 synthesis (18,331.39 um^2, 1,478.99 ps on msh_deq.v; 3.610342 mm^2, 6.166 ns full chip).

fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.instrument: ArchEval (L1 Lookup vs. L3 Counter-Factual Sensitivity)
fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.connection: Tests whether an architect can predict physical sensitivity before running EDA—e.g., why a 16-way parallel byte demux explodes by +96,000 gates and why unbuffered wireload STA reports 266,515 ps until two-pass ABC buffering reduces delay 180.2x to 1,479 ps.
Applies the fleet-scale equivalent of our 2x DRAM latency chaos testbench: injecting link-latency jitter and incast congestion to expose rigid, non-credit-tracked collectives.

cross_stack_sightline.sightline_takeaway: A single nominal simulation is gameable at both the RTL module level and the 16-node cluster level; Stage 4 requires orthogonal static, chaos-timing, and physical synthesis referees.

labs.title: Causal Credit Assignment & The Three Return Arrows
book_chapters: Chapter 3: The AI-Native Design Life Cycle
Chapter 6: Execution Harnesses and Tool Isolation

turns.name: Turn 1: Unaligned Shift / Zero-Point & Static Audit Failure
turns.symptom: fxmodel.py vs RTL diverges at Row 0, Col 0 (<<13 vs <<14); unreset control flop fails randreset.
turns.prescribed_action: Localize first differing row/element against fxmodel.py (<<14 shift in msh_deq.v, zero-point fold in msh_gemv.v) and ensure all control flops reset cleanly.

turns.name: Turn 2: 2x DRAM Latency Collapse, Single-Bank qacc RMW Stall & 96K-Gate Demux
turns.symptom: 2x DRAM latency slows chip by 1.88x; single qacc SRAM stalls 2-chunk MAC; 16-way demux adds +96K gates.
turns.prescribed_action: Replace 16-way parallel byte demux in msh_deq (-96K gates) with byte-serial emitter, add 256-deep credit-tracked FIFO in msh_fetch, split qacc SRAM into even/odd parity banks, and add 16 KiB hq LM-head shadow cache.

turns.name: Turn 3: Layer-2 Uncompressed FP16 Pin-Bandwidth Ceiling
turns.symptom: Even at 100% bus utilization, FP16 weight stream (304,448 B/tok) hits 19,028 cyc/tok floor (5,255 tok/s max).
turns.prescribed_action: Hardware-only optimization cannot beat conservation of bytes (FP16 requires 19,028 cyc/tok floor). Escalate from Layer 2 (hardware-only) to Layer 3 co-design: INT4 group-128 fused dequantization + Q4.26 numerics.

turns.name: Turn 4: Converged INT4 Co-Design + Dual-Parity GEMV + 256-Deep Credit Fetch
turns.symptom: 11,467.125 cyc/tok measured vs 11,200 predicted (2.33% error); 8,720.6 tok/s; 3.610 mm^2; 6.166 ns.
turns.prescribed_action: Freeze RTL and fxmodel.py, bind SHA-256 evidence packets, disclose pre-layout wireload/blackbox proxy gaps, and sign Design-Loop Card v2.0.

cross_stack_sightline.node_level_anchor: nano-kpu (msh_chip_top): Causal Credit Router maps multi-modal Stage 4 telemetry across the Three Return Arrows (Turn 1 -> 3. Implement, Turn 2 -> 2. Explore, Turn 3 -> 1. Formulate) and advances Turn 4 -> 6. Commit once perf-model error reaches 2.33% (<= 5%).

fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.connection: Distinguishes implementation bugs from microarchitectural queue/banking hazards and representation rooflines so the search policy modifies the true bottleneck variable.

fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.instrument: MLPerf Agents (Joules & Simulator Calls per Verified Outcome)
fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.connection: Accounts for the full trajectory cost of agentic design: routing via the Three Return Arrows converges in 4 directed turns (~1.92 kJ total EDA+LLM energy) vs. 42+ blind Stage-3 retries (~20.16 kJ wasted without converging).

cross_stack_sightline.sightline_takeaway: In both RTL synthesis loops and fleet-scale agentic benchmarks, Stage 5 Interpret turns raw referee failures into causal credit assignment—slashing joules-per-verified-outcome by >10x.

labs.title: Signoff Governance, Proxy Gaps & The Design-Loop Card v2.0
book_chapters: Chapter 3: The AI-Native Design Life Cycle

accountable_decision.authorized_scope: Pre-layout RTL architecture signoff, open-source reproducible benchmark release, and progression to physical P&R experimentation.
reopen_conditions: Any SHA-256 mismatch in harness/manifest.json or evidence packets during replay.
Failure on hidden evaluation seeds (group_size=64 or stretched sequence lengths up to max_seq=64).
Post-layout OpenROAD routing congestion, macro placement channel blockage, or SPEF RC timing violations exceeding the 10.0 ns clock period.

cross_stack_sightline.node_level_anchor: nano-kpu (msh_chip_top): Design-Loop Card v2.0 (nano-kpu-study-card.yaml) normalizes 8,720.58 tok/s (2,180.15x over 4.0 tok/s scalar FP32 baseline = 41.5% of the 21,021.7 tok/s raw INT4 DRAM pin roofline), discloses pre-layout Nangate45 proxy gaps (5K_hvratio_1_1 wireload, 39 blackboxed SRAM/ROM macros, single-corner STA), and separates model proposal from human commit.

fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.connection: Prevents 'Claim Bomb' denominator inflation by requiring every headline speedup (2,180.15x) to be paired with its physical roofline utilization (4,757 / 11,467.125 = 41.5% of pin bandwidth).

fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.instrument: wakeword-rv32 SKY130 Post-Route GDSII & Antenna Signoff
fleet_and_ecosystem_instruments.connection: Demonstrates what lies beyond nano-kpu's pre-layout Yosys gate: OpenROAD placement, CTS, detailed routing, SPEF parasitic extraction, multi-corner STA, and diode insertion for SKY130 antenna signoff.

cross_stack_sightline.sightline_takeaway: Stage 6 Commit is the governance firewall: an AI model may propose and recommend, the frozen harness may execute and reject, but only a human authority can commit after proxy gaps and denominators are audited.
